To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
bigram indexing and TFIDF based canopy clustering are the two most accurate blocking methods.
bigram indexing and TFIDF canopy clustering are scalable blocking methods with improved record linkage accuracy compared to the traditional blocking methods.

(1) bigram indexing and TFIDF canopy clustering provide scalable methods of record linkage; (2) bigram indexing has a higher accuracy than sorted neighborhood blocking and canopy clustering has a higher accuracy that bigram indexing; (3) bigram indexing is faster than sorted neighborhood blocking; (4) canopy clustering is slower than sorted neighborhood blocking

the development of efficient and scalable record linkage systems for the linkage of large data sets.
developing scalable record linkage methods which can be applied to very large databases.

bigram indexing is an excellent blocking method for record linkage and that canopy clustering with TF-IDF is a very good blocking method for record linking.
canopy clustering with TF-IDF is the most effective blocking method in terms of accuracy and speed, and should be used as the standard blocking method for record linkage.

the new methods are better than the old methods.
